items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) listed as non-participant Thursday one day after injuring it in practice; doctors do not believe it is serious but Week 2 status vs Bengals is in jeopardy. Grade 1 strain diagnosed.
items.why: Hamstring injury at Wed practice; history of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024; MRI/tests done.
items.implication: High-end WR2/WR1 risk for Week 2; bench pending Friday practice/status.
items.opportunity: Routes last week 37/42 on Stroud dropbacks; if OUT, volume to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday for second straight practice after exiting Week 1 with injury; day-to-day but availability for Saints game increasingly uncertain.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 1; missed Wed/Thu practices.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Bateman elevates as primary; Ja'Kobi Lane already IR/return.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow listed limited participant Thursday for second consecutive day due to back injury/tightness; he has stated he expects to play and called sitting ridiculous.
items.why: Back tightness post-Week 1; limited throwing but mental reps; plans to play vs Texans.
items.implication: QB1 still startable but monitor for any Friday full participation or limitations affecting Chase/Higgins/Brown.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), who missed Week 1, says he is ready to go for Sunday home opener vs Steelers after full practices; set to return and share with Stevenson.
items.why: Full participant Wed/Thu; self-declared ready after Aug ankle injury.
items.implication: High-upside flex/RB2 return; Stevenson workload drops from 23 touches.
items.opportunity: Explosive big-play role resumes; AJ Brown already IR increases need.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR/return.
items.why: Flowers second straight DNP; Lane already sidelined.
items.implication: Bateman becomes must-add/start if Flowers OUT; Lane stash for return.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets (tied team lead), 24% target share Week 1. IND just gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Elite early usage/target share in new Chiefs offense + juicy matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season potential if healthy.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse if Kamara back); plus Devaughn Vele, streamers.
items.why: Precise next-man-up from injuries/IR (Brown IR, Stribling IR, Lane IR, McConkey banged, Kamara status).
items.implication: Priority adds: Deebo, Bateman, Vele, Miller handcuff, Doubs.
items.opportunity: Immediate role expansion for listed beneficiaries.

items.text: Matthew Berry back in on DeVonta Smith this week despite tough Week 1; on the LOVE list with 27% target share and 13.7 aDOT (three deep looks). Tennessee allows high catch rate/YPR.
items.why: Strong target share/aDOT in Week 1 + soft TEN secondary matchup.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Walker 24% tgt share (2nd career high); Jeanty util 99 (tied Bijan); Loveland 89% routes (TE high, buy low); Kincaid 69% routes/77% snaps (highest recent, healthy breakout); Irving 26% tgt + all RZ.
items.why: Week 1 opportunity metrics signal sustained roles.
items.implication: Buy/ start Walker/Jeanty/Irving/Kincaid; buy-low Loveland on routes despite 0 pts.
items.opportunity: Route/target/RZ shares confirm three-down or featured work.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty (99 utilization score Week 1, tied Bijan; high target share) @ LAC and Bucky Irving (career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell) vs CLE.
items.why: Elite util/usage metrics Week 1 + favorable matchups.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex starts; Jeanty high-end RB1 upside.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI (37% tgt share from Wentz, strong history), Dalton Kincaid vs DET (69% routes highest since '24, high snaps/util), Mike Evans vs MIA (25% RZ tgts, led routes).
items.implication: Lock starts; Kincaid TE breakout candidate if healthy.
items.opportunity: Jefferson volume; Kincaid route share expansion; Evans RZ.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week per Berry (Stribling to IR opens path).
items.why: 49ers WR depth hit by Stribling IR; Deebo proven producer.
items.implication: Priority WW add for flex/WR3 upside.

items.text: Sounds like Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. Same left knee as prior PCL/bone bruise—scary but optimistic timeline.
items.why: Coach comments on working hard to rejoin; meniscus trim typically short absence.
items.opportunity: If active early, immediate high-end TE usage.
